```plato
//==
// # Scene3D
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - 3D scenes
//  - Scene index types
//  - Scene instancing and levels of detail

//==
// # 3D scenes
//
// A retained scene description: a node hierarchy plus flat resource pools.
// All cross-references are zero-based Integer indices with -1 meaning "none".
// IIndex spaces: SceneNode3D.Mesh indexes SceneResources.Meshes;
// SceneNode3D.Material indexes SceneResources.Materials; SceneNode3D.Light
// indexes SceneResources.LightBindings; SceneNode3D.Camera indexes
// SceneResources.CameraBindings. A binding then selects into the typed arrays
// of SceneLightSet or SceneCameraSet via its case.

// A node in the scene hierarchy. Parent is the index of the parent node in
// Scene3D.Nodes (-1 = a root); Transform is relative to the parent. Mesh,
// Material, Light, and ICamera attach resources by index (-1 = none); a node's
// Material overrides the attached mesh's default. LayerMask is a bitmask over
// RenderLayer indices: bit i set means the node belongs to the layer with
// IIndex i.
type SceneNode3D
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Parent: SceneNodeIndex3D;
    Transform: TrsTransform3D;
    Visible: Boolean;
    Mesh: MeshIndex;
    Material: MaterialIndex;
    Light: LightBindingIndex;
    Camera: CameraBindingIndex;
    LayerMask: Integer;
}

// Node visibility for pipelines needing a tri-state instead of the plain
// SceneNode3D.Visible flag: follow the parent (Inherited), or force the node
// shown or hidden (including all descendants).
type Visibility = Inherited | Visible | Hidden;

// All lights of a scene grouped into typed arrays; SceneLightBinding entries
// address into these. Each array is an independent zero-based index space.
type SceneLightSet
    implements IValue
{
    DirectionalLights: Array<DirectionalLight>;
    PointLights: Array<PointLight>;
    SpotLights: Array<SpotLight>;
    AreaLights: Array<AreaLight>;
    DiskLights: Array<DiskLight>;
    SphereLights: Array<SphereLight>;
    TubeLights: Array<TubeLight>;
    EnvironmentLights: Array<EnvironmentLight>;
    ProceduralSkies: Array<ProceduralSky>;
    AmbientLights: Array<AmbientLight>;
}

// A tagged reference to one light: the case picks the typed array of
// SceneLightSet and IIndex is the position within that array.
type SceneLightBinding
    implements IValue
    = Directional(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Point(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Spot(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Area(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Disk(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Sphere(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Tube(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Environment(Index: ItemIndex)
    | ProceduralSkyLight(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Ambient(Index: ItemIndex);

// All cameras of a scene grouped into typed arrays; SceneCameraBinding
// entries address into these. Each array is an independent zero-based index
// space.
type SceneCameraSet
    implements IValue
{
    PerspectiveCameras: Array<PerspectiveCamera>;
    OrthographicCameras: Array<OrthographicCamera>;
    PhysicalCameras: Array<PhysicalCamera>;
    FisheyeCameras: Array<FisheyeCamera>;
    EquirectangularCameras: Array<EquirectangularCamera>;
    PanoramicCameras: Array<PanoramicCamera>;
}

// A tagged reference to one camera: the case picks the typed array of
// SceneCameraSet and IIndex is the position within that array. Distinct from
// CameraProjection (`cameras.types.plato`): a Physical camera projects perspectively but
// is stored in its own array.
type SceneCameraBinding
    implements IValue
    = Perspective(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Orthographic(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Physical(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Fisheye(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Equirectangular(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Panoramic(Index: ItemIndex);

// The shared resource pools of a scene; node and instance indices resolve
// here. Meshes come from `meshes.types.plato`, materials from `materials.types.plato`.
type SceneResources
    implements IValue
{
    Meshes: Array<TriangleMesh3D>;
    Materials: Array<Material>;
    Lights: SceneLightSet;
    LightBindings: Array<SceneLightBinding>;
    Cameras: SceneCameraSet;
    CameraBindings: Array<SceneCameraBinding>;
}

// A named rendering layer. IIndex is the bit position used by SceneNode3D
// LayerMask and LightLayerMask values; valid indices are 0 through 31.
type RenderLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Index: Integer;
}

//==
// # The scene

// A complete scene: hierarchy, resource pools, layers, instancing, and levels
// of detail. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scene_graph)
type Scene3D
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Nodes: Array<SceneNode3D>;
    Resources: SceneResources;
    Layers: Array<RenderLayer>;
    Instances: Array<InstanceSet>;
    LodGroups: Array<LodGroup>;
}

// Aggregate counts summarizing a scene's contents and rendering cost.
// LightCount and CameraCount total the binding tables across all typed arrays.
type SceneStatistics
    implements IValue
{
    NodeCount: Integer;
    MeshCount: Integer;
    MaterialCount: Integer;
    LightCount: Integer;
    CameraCount: Integer;
    InstanceCount: Integer;
    TriangleCount: Integer;
    VertexCount: Integer;
}
```
